statement: Linux DS4 full input structs have one touch-report count followed by up to three USB or four Bluetooth nine-byte touch samples; each sample carries a timestamp plus two four-byte contact points. Kernel checks count does not exceed the respective array size before processing.

applicability.revision: research revisions: Linux 4056b3c, historical Linux v6.1 830b3c6, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e, community 290e4a2; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 454–505, 2395–2441, 2527–2547. Three/four counts are packet *history slots*, not simultaneous fingers.
